decision_ref: user request 2026-09-17: build the G3/G6 lever package the reward-mechanism forecast points to (ang_vel_xy_l2 -0.05 -> -0.08 on G-A033). Server execution is still not released; this is a local package.

external_reference.after_change_vs_go2_rough: two terms differ: feet_air_time (0.2 vs 0.01, inherited from G-A033) and ang_vel_xy_l2 (-0.08 vs -0.05, this run)
external_reference.departure_reason: Isaac Lab formula (envs/mdp/rewards.py ang_vel_xy_l2): sum of squared body roll/pitch rates. On G-A033 evaluation trajectories the robots 0.5-1.0 s before a rough side-step fall have a roll/pitch-rate lower bound far above the survivors (difference -10.7676), and this sign agrees across Pilot-01, A017 and G-A033. The Isaac Lab value is a comparison anchor, not proof of an optimum (MASTER 1-b).
external_reference.literature: R-Sci-4 (Hwangbo 2019): a penalty the objective motion must pay is a stall risk; here the walk margin (GO2_REWARD_MECHANISM_FORECAST.md section 2) is checked to stay in the walking zone
external_reference.r6: reward weight only; curriculum, terrain, DR, commands untouched

value_derivation.source: reports/GO2_REWARD_MECHANISM_FORECAST.md sections 2, 3, 5-1 and 6-0; evidence reports/evidence/go2_reward_mechanism_20260917/ (RUN_MARGIN.csv, SITUATIONS.csv, PROBE_SITUATIONS.csv)
value_derivation.role: Penalize xy-axis base angular velocity using L2 squared kernel (Isaac Lab v2.3.1): the rate of rolling and pitching, not the tilt itself.
value_derivation.walk_margin: G-A033 walk margin +0.1359 -> +0.0728 at -0.08 (WALK); the walking zone ends at weight -0.107243. A016 (-0.15 on Pilot-01) stopped because Pilot-01 sat in the boundary band (+0.0033); on G-A033 -0.15 is also predicted STOP, -0.08 is not.
value_derivation.situations: partial margin change vs G-A033: side-step sway +0.3230 (the pre-fall state is penalised more on all 3 policies), push +0.1535 (more on both policies with >= 5 fallen robots), stairs climb -0.0107 (roll/pitch-rate lower bound, so the stairs cost may be larger).
value_derivation.rule: a step that keeps the walk margin (+0.0728) above every stopped run (max +0.0155) and close to the walking run A017 (+0.0917); -0.08 is the deployed start value; the runs that carried it all stopped, but every one also had lin_vel_z -3 or track <= 1.2 and sits in the stop zone of the same margin (forecast section 2). No value between -0.05 and -0.08 has been trained
value_derivation.not_claimed: The margins are reward arithmetic on measured behaviour (G-A033 trajectories and training logs). They say the reward prefers upright states more strongly; they do not predict how many robots stop falling. No score gain is estimated.

rejected_alternatives.lin_vel_z_l2: strengthening also raises sway/push margins but lowers walk and stairs margins (forecast 6-0); weakening (G-A037) lowers sway and push
rejected_alternatives.flat_orientation_l2: second choice: its side-step sign disagrees across the three policies (forecast 5-1) and it charges every slope and stair constantly
rejected_alternatives.track_lin_vel_xy_exp: held at 1.5: rough side-step terminations rose on the grade-A pair 1.4 -> 1.5 (per-seed mean 19.333 of 32 robots on G-A033)
rejected_alternatives.feet_air_time: held at 0.2: lowering it cut slope progress (A031, grade A); raising it lowers the walk margin
rejected_alternatives.dof_acc_l2: the G5 lever of the forecast; no situation measurement exists for it, so it is a separate information run, not mixed into this one

evaluation.checkpoint_rule: same training length and seed as G-A033, so the candidate is read at the checkpoint G-A033 was read at (900 of 1000). finalize's reward pick is kept as training/model_best_by_reward.pt and is not evaluated.

sentinel_tolerance.note: same as G-A035, G-A033 and G-A030. Evaluation replay measured delta 0.0000 (A017 sentinel, 6 days apart), so exceeding it means remeasure the baseline, not a verdict on the candidate

detectability.basis: Primary readout is the termination count, not the 70-point total. G-A033 per-seed terminations: rough_lateral 19.333, push_pos_x 2.667, push_neg_x 2.000, stairs_10_down 2.000 (GO2_VARIABLE_INFLUENCE PAIR_METRICS.csv). The rough side-step count moved on every seed at the last single change (A017 -> G-A033).
detectability.expected_gain_basis: Not estimated in points. The forecast gives the direction of the reward preference, not the size of the behaviour change.
detectability.seed_noise: Every training run used seed 42. One run cannot separate the lever from seed luck; a seed replicate of G-A033 is the control this run lacks (R-6 reading pending with the user).

waiver.reason: Exploratory run without a point-gain estimate, recorded as such. Built on the user request of 2026-09-17; the server run itself is not released.

preregistered.source: GO2_REWARD_MECHANISM_FORECAST.md section 8 (four zones) on the criteria of GO2_BASIC_MOTION_TUNING_PLAN_20260915.md section 6-1, limits measured as in G-A035 section 15-4
preregistered.threshold_basis: Measured, not intended. tools/go2_eval_resolution.py (reports/runs/BASELINE_MARGIN.csv delta_resample_sd) gave per-scenario weighted-score standard deviations of G3 1.01823, G4 0.49816, G6 0.43098, G2 0.28229, G7 0.20179, G5 0.02802, G1 0.00000 (/70) and a total-difference sd of 1.26443/70. Each non-flat scenario may lose at most twice its own sd (max_scenario_weighted_loss_70_by_scenario); flat G1/G2 use max_flat_scenario_proxy_drop 2x0.28229/10.5 = 0.054 and max_flat_case_survival_drop 2 robots of 32. max_scenario_weighted_loss_70 keeps G-A035's uniform 2.04 as the fallback for any scenario not listed. min_total_points_delta is the 2-sigma detection limit 2.53. min_target_mean_proxy_delta 0.05 and min_target_groups_improved 2 are section 6-1's values, unchanged.

target_group_roles.rough_lateral: the G3 min-case and the sway situation this lever aims at (forecast 5-1)
target_group_roles.push_pos_x: the push case with the most G-A033 terminations; the push situation this lever aims at
target_group_roles.stairs_10_climb: the axis this lever may cost (stairs partial margin falls, forecast 6-0). In the target mean a climbing regression pulls criterion 1 down before the full stage

preregistered.mechanism_readout: termination counts of rough_lateral and the four push cases, climbed-step counts of stairs_10_down and stairs_15_down (tools/go2_stairs_behavior.py rules), and the situation table of tools/go2_reward_mechanism.py rebuilt on the candidate. Recorded, not a criterion.
preregistered.video: human reading; the verifier reports VIDEO_UNKNOWN

reasons.G3:rough_lateral:101: the side-step roll-over this lever aims at. No stored G-A033 video, so the baseline is rendered here.
reasons.G6:push_pos_x:101: recovery after a forward push. No stored G-A033 video, so the baseline is rendered here.
reasons.G3:rough_forward:101: rough forward walking: a stronger roll/pitch-rate penalty may slow or stiffen the gait on uneven ground
reasons.G4:slope_plus_20:101: G-A033 climbs the slope to the end; guard against losing it

videos.baseline_counterparts: workspace/_keep/go2_g_a033_a017_track_lin_vel_xy_150/evaluation/candidate/videos (G-A033, same 4 env x 500 step) for rough_forward and slope_plus_20. The 10cm climb has no stored video; it is a target group and is judged from steps.csv

target.decides: criterion 1 only; a target-stage failure is final for this arm

why: Goal: every axis high while stairs rise. G-A033 loses most on G5 (stairs) and G3 (rough side-step); G6 (push) also loses.
Role first (Isaac Lab formula): ang_vel_xy_l2 penalises the rate of rolling and pitching.
Measured on G-A033 trajectories: robots about to fall on a rough side-step or after a push roll and pitch far faster than survivors.
That direction agrees on Pilot-01, A017 and G-A033 for the side-step, and on A017 and G-A033 for pushes (forecast 5-1).
Walk margin: -0.08 stays in the walking zone on G-A033. A016 (-0.15) stopped from a Pilot-01 base that sat in the boundary band.
Cost named in advance: the stairs partial margin falls a little, so the 10cm climb is a target group.
Levers not moved: track (side-step terminations rose at 1.5), flat_orientation (sign disagrees), lin_vel_z (costs walk/stairs), feet_air, dof_acc.
Risks pre-registered: stopping (walk zone), 10cm climb, slope, and every scenario loss limit of G-A037.

notes.comparison_validity: Same seed 42, 4096 envs, 1000 iterations, evaluator and registry SHA as the stored G-A033 arm, evaluated at the same checkpoint iteration. The only difference is ang_vel_xy_l2.
notes.not_claimed: No score gain is promised. One training seed cannot separate the lever from seed luck.
notes.control_arm: A G-A033 seed replicate is recommended as the control; it is not in this package because a seed-only run is outside the reward-weight reading of R-6 until the user decides.
